news.title: Restoration Druid Change to Wild Growth in WoW: Forever
news.description: Restoration Druids have gotten a change to Wild Growth today in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
Restoration Druid Guide
In a hotfix today, Restoration Druids got a few changes to Wild Growth, the capstone talent in their tree.
Wild Growth
Can no longer be cast while moving.
Spell power coefficient increased by 100% to 0.066 (was 0.033)
It's unclear why Wild Growth could be cast while moving with the launch of WoW: Forever, but this is no longer the case. In its place, though, is Wild Growth getting double the spell power benefit, likely to help offset the nerf.

news.title: Dual Spec Costs 50 Gold at Level 40 - Unlock Secondary Talent Tree
news.description: Dual spec is available in WoW: Forever, but it costs 50 gold!
news.details:
While the Classic 20th Anniversary Realms didn't release Dual Spec at launch , WoW: Forever features Dual spec right from the start if you have enough gold! Once you reach level 40 in WoW: Forever, your class trainer allows you to purchase your secondary talent tree for 50 gold.
Your secondary spec (Dual spec) allows you to have a second separate talent build, which you can swap to and from this secondary talent build whenever you want. As respeccing your talent tree costs an increasing amount of Gold, dual spec allows players to have two different talent builds for whatever reason. Maybe you want to have a build for Tank and DPS, or a build for PvE and a build for PvP. Dual spec is very versatile, especially when you plan on swapping your talent builds frequently.

news.title: Explore the Drowned City: New Dungeon in WoW: Forever
news.description: The Drowned City is a new dungeon that challenges players in the Level 37-42 bracket in WoW: Forever - take a look at the quests and rewards you'll find inside!
news.details:
Drowned City Dungeon Guide
Our dungeon guide has everything you'll need to tackle this dungeon: where to find it, boss strategies, notable trash, and more. Stay tuned for our Dungeon Journal tool to update as well!
New Dungeon: The Drowned City
Drowned City is a level 37-42 Dungeon located in Stranglethorn Vale, off the far coast west of the peninsula. This is a major step up in difficulty compared to the previous dungeons in WoW: Forever, and players will need to pay attention to mechanics more than usual.
Drowned City Quests
There are a total of 5 quests for this dungeon for both the Alliance and Horde. Two are located in Booty Bay and are neutral quests, one direct pickup for both factions, and the last two being unlocked through a series of quests prior.

news.title: Gelkis or Magram: Which to Pick in WoW: Forever?
news.description: When you start questing in Desolace in WoW: Forever, there are two competing clans to choose from - the Gelkis or the Magram. Which side is the better choice?
news.details:
When you reach Desolace around level 35 in World of Warcraft: Forever, you have the option to side with one of two rival clans: the Gelkis or the Magram. As you gain reputation with one, you lose it with the other, so you will have to choose carefully.
Gelkis Clan Centaur Reputation Guide Magram Clan Centaur Reputation Guide
Regardless of which faction you choose, you will be able to acquire all 12 crafting recipes (2 per crafting profession); however, the requirements are different for each faction, so it will be easier to get the recipes you are after if you pick the right side.
Enchanters, Leatherworkers, and Tailors
Players with one of these three professions will probably want to side with the Gelkis clan.

news.title: Blizzard Addressing Missing Shaman Totems Due to Monday's Server Issue in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard has fixed an issue with missing Shaman totems due to server issues on Monday.
news.details:
Yesterday, at around 1 PM PST time, the WoW servers had issues and needed to come down for emergency maintenance. During this time, players reported some issues, including missing totems on Shamans such as Fire Totem. Blizzard has addressed this and it should be restored now.
We have just deployed a fix for this to all regions. Shamans who lost a totem due to the crash should find it restored to their bag.
Shamans who experienced the disappearance, who are currently in-game, will need to make sure you have bag space, and then logout and back in to receive them.
